This '''resistance group''' was formed on the planet [[Chelloa]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]] to resist the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], who ruled the planet as part of a fiefdom known as the [[Daimanate]]. Two known members of the resistance included the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gorlan Palladane]] and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] mechanic [[Skodo]]. Known actions during the [[Chelloan affair]] included assisting a Jedi strike force led by [[Vannar Treece]] during [[Operation Influx]], sheltering the Jedi Knight [[Kerra Holt]], and spearheading evacuation efforts during the [[Destruction of Chelloa]]. They also possessed a [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] which was used to send a distress signal to the Jedi and to provide [[Odion]] with false intelligence about the end of [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] mining operations. They helped establish the [[Freedom Fleet]] which succeeded in evacuating the Chelloan population to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-controlled space in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].
